description: This PHP source file defines the `GenericRestController` class, which is part of an API handling framework for a Human Resource Management system (OrangeHRM). The class provides RESTful API endpoint logic, handling CRUD operations via different HTTP methods, and interacts with endpoint classes to process API requests and generate responses.
external_methods: Array methods like all() in meta and rel objects

classes.name: GenericRestController
classes.description: A REST API controller class that manages CRUD operations for resources by delegating to endpoint classes, handling request validation, and generating structured responses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the API endpoint based on request attributes and class instantiation, throwing exceptions if configuration is invalid.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests, retrieving either a single resource or a collection depending on the request parameters.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for GET requests based on whether it's a single or collection fetch.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create new resources using the API endpoint.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for POST requests.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update existing resources.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for PUT requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete resources.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getNotInstanceOfException
methods.description: Generates an exception indicating that an endpoint class does not implement the expected interface.

methods.name: isGetOneRequest
methods.description: Determines if the incoming request is for a single resource based on request attributes.

methods.name: getPreparedResponseParamsFromResult
methods.description: Prepares response parameters, including data, metadata, and relationships, from the result object.
